summary: Verified session changes: POS backend endpoints, auth/login trim fix, POS + Invoices frontend flow, multi-role login redirects, and social.tsx text-node warnings. Backend: 12/12 passing (1 skip). All POS endpoints work — POST /api/pos/invoice creates INV-000001-style numbered invoice with correct 15% VAT (subtotal*1.15 = total, verified within 0.01 tolerance), GET /api/pos/invoices lists newly created invoice, GET /api/pos/invoice/{id} returns full details, customer/anonymous is 403/401, empty items → 400. Auth trim fix confirmed — merchant/driver/chamber/customer all log in successfully, whitespace-padded credentials ('  0540001111  ' / '  driver1234  ') now succeed (200), invalid password returns 401 with Arabic detail. Frontend (Playwright 390x844): merchant login → dashboard shows both 'نقطة البيع POS' and 'الفواتير' quick actions; POS screen renders header 'نقاط البيع POS', branch chips (2 branches), search input, product cards with prices; tapping product adds to cart, cart bar appears with total, 'إنهاء البيع' opens checkout modal with subtotal/ضريبة 15%/الإجمالي/4 payment method chips/'إصدار الفاتورة'; issuing invoice succeeds — /merchant/invoices now shows INV-000001 and INV-000002 with totals 5747.70 & 2873.85 ر.س and 'كاش' badge. Multi-role redirects all work: 0540001111→/driver, 0550000000→/chamber, 0509999999→/merchant, 0500000000→/. HOWEVER, social.tsx text-node warning fix is INCOMPLETE — 15 'Unexpected text node' console errors still fire when scrolling the customer /social feed. Root cause: only the OUTER conditional on line 228 was wrapped with !!(); the 8 inner conditionals (`{storeInfo.whatsapp && ...}`, `{storeInfo.phone && ...}`, etc. lines 232-279) still render empty string when the corresponding field is '' (falsy but not boolean), producing stray text nodes inside the <ScrollView>/<View>. Also note that at line 195 inside <Text style={s.eventText}>, the expression `{post.event_date} {post.event_location && `...`}` is inside <Text> so that particular one is safe.

react_native_issues.issue: 15× 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' still fires on customer /social feed. The session's fix on line 228 wrapped only the outer conditional with !!(); the 8 inner conditionals (storeInfo.whatsapp && ..., storeInfo.phone && ..., storeInfo.email && ..., storeInfo.instagram && ..., storeInfo.tiktok && ..., storeInfo.snapchat && ..., storeInfo.twitter && ..., storeInfo.telegram && ...) on lines 232-279 still render the empty string when the field is '' (falsy string). Change each `{storeInfo.X && (...)}` to `{!!storeInfo.X && (...)}` or gate with typeof check. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/social.tsx:232,238,244,250,256,262,268,274.

action_items: FIX (Frontend, LOW-MED): In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/social.tsx lines 232, 238, 244, 250, 256, 262, 268, 274 convert each `{storeInfo.<field> && (...)}` to `{!!storeInfo.<field> && (...)}` (or `{storeInfo.<field> ? (...) : null}`) so an empty-string field does not render a stray text node. Retest the customer /social scroll — expect 0 text-node warnings.

OPTIONAL (Backend): Consider exposing GET /api/merchant/branch-inventory/{branch_id} publicly to merchants so testing agent can verify inventory decrement automatically (currently returned non-200 during automated test and was skipped).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/pos/invoice: invoice_number is derived from `db.invoices.count_documents({})` — this is NOT unique across merchants (all merchants share the same INV-000001 counter) and is vulnerable to race conditions on concurrent inserts. Consider per-merchant counter or use ObjectId + separate sequence collection.
POST /api/pos/invoice: no stock validation before decrement; branch_inventory quantity can go negative. Consider `$inc` guarded by `{quantity: {$gte: qty}}` and rollback if not matched.

GET /api/pos/invoice/{iid}: serialize_doc returns raw invoice but there's NO ownership check (merchant_id / employee_id) — any authenticated merchant/employee could fetch another merchant's invoice by guessing ObjectId. Add filter `{'_id': ObjectId(iid), 'merchant_id': user.get('merchant_id', user['id'])}`.
auth/login now correctly strips leading/trailing whitespace from both phone and password. Good fix.

InvoiceInput uses `discount: float = 0` at line-item and top-level — top-level subtotal calculation subtracts line discount inside sum(), then subtracts data.discount from total. Verify UI aligns with this semantic (currently POS screen sends discount:0 for all items and no top-level discount, so fine).
POS screen `useCallback(load, [])` has empty deps but references `apiCall` — since apiCall is stable in the AuthProvider this works, but adding to deps would be cleaner.
POS `checkout()` reads `r.total.toFixed(2)` directly — if the API ever returns null/undefined this crashes; consider `(r.total ?? 0).toFixed(2)`.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 pytest, 1 skip due to branch-inventory endpoint access)

Two invoices are now persisted for the merchant — subsequent invoice-list tests will see them cumulatively.
rca_of_issue: social.tsx text-node warning: JSX expression `{storeInfo.whatsapp && (...)}` evaluates to the string '' (empty string) when `storeInfo.whatsapp === ''`, and React renders '' as a text node. In native RN this triggers 'Text strings must be rendered within a <Text> component'; on RN-Web it manifests as 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' The session's fix wrapped only the outermost condition on line 228 with `!!(...)`, but the eight inner social-channel conditionals (lines 232-279) were left as raw truthy-string checks. Fix: coerce each inner check to boolean via `!!` or use ternary `? : null`. Reproduction: login as customer 0500000000/test1234 → tap Social tab → scroll — 15 warnings fire because at least one seeded post has a partial storeInfo where some channels are '' and others are set.
